promises.quote: The HSE intends to issue additional guidance concerning the inspection of two post ramps by thorough examiners to highlight the risks in relation to this type of lifting equipment. This will be covered in HSE Operational Guidance, which will be brought to the attention of the various stakeholder groups, namely the inspection industry and will also be publically available on the HSE website.
promises.summary: Issue guidance on inspecting two-post lifts to prevent safety failures

promises.quote: issued a technical document on the 3 May 2017 to its engineering surveyors which instructed them to record the pad wear (tolerance) on the report of thorough examination for two post vehicle lifting tables
promises.summary: document issued to record pad wear tolerance for two-post lifts
